# Compliance & AI Trust Checklist: Saakh KCC Appraisal Agent

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements covering RBI KCC rule fidelity, human oversight, AI boundaries,
audit and privacy
**Created**: 2026-11-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive run): depth Standard, audience PR reviewer, focus on regulatory fidelity and
AI/human trust boundaries.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all RBI KCC Directions, 2026 paragraphs that affect the limit (6, 8, 10, 13(1) to 13(7), 23 to 25, 30) mapped to at least one requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for loans first sanctioned before 1 Jan 2027 that come up for renewal? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is the handling of allied-activity limits (para 16) explicitly scoped in or out? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what the officer sees when SoF source is proxy versus official? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for which events must appear in the audit record, including AI model fallbacks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "deterministic rules only" stated precisely enough that an AI-produced number anywhere in the flow would violate a named requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is the rounding and yearly compounding order specified, or explicitly flagged as an open interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK008 Is "tamper-evident" defined with a verifiable mechanism and expected verification outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "required inputs" for FR-006 enumerated (district, land, tenure, at least one mapped crop line)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are officer identity requirements (named profile, no password) consistent with FR-009's "named officer" approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Are language requirements consistent between FR-007 (all supported languages), SC-004 (six verified) and the UI language scope? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK012 Do the edge case for long-duration crops and the assumption on 18-month seasons agree with para 6(4)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Is SC-001 measurable before the RBI Annex I illustrations are obtained? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is the sample set size for SC-003 extraction accuracy specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-005 "0 uncited figures" verifiable automatically rather than by manual review only? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for an officer overriding the engine limit upward beyond the computed CMPL? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for code-mixed speech and local crop names mapping to SoF keys? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are failure requirements defined when an AI provider is unavailable (manual entry path)? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 4]

## Non-Functional: Privacy & Security

- [ ] CHK019 Is Aadhaar masking specified at capture time, not only at storage time? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Are retention rules for exported JSON files and on-device data specified? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Is it specified that API credentials never reach the device? [Gap, Plan §Constraints]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK022 Is the PMFBY-sum-insured-as-SoF proxy assumption documented with its source and limitation? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Is the dependency on third-party speech, vision and translation services and their latency target documented? [Dependency, Spec §SC-008]

## Notes

- Items are unchecked by design; the reviewer marks them.
- Reviewed 2026-11-26 against spec.md as amended (US7, US8, FR-017 to FR-025). 12 of 23 pass. Open:
  CHK001 (para 6(4) only in Assumptions; paras 19 and 29 used but not in FR-001/FR-003), CHK005 (model
  fallbacks not named as audit events), CHK006 (FR-019 covers agent text, but no FR says note figures must come
  from the engine; only the contract does), CHK009 (FR-006 inputs not enumerated), CHK011 (SC-012 extends
  parity to 13 languages against the 6 in Clarifications; UI language scope not stated), CHK015 (citations
  checked by review only), CHK016 (upward override not specified), CHK018 (provider outage for capture not
  specified; agent outage is, US7 scenario 6), CHK019 (masking point not stated in spec), CHK020 (no retention
  rule), CHK021 (key handling only in plan and constitution).
